title: Koko Eating Bananas
tip: Binary search on the answer (speed k).
statement:
Koko has `piles[i]` bananas in pile i. Guards return in `h` hours. She eats at speed `k` bananas/hour, one pile at a time, rounding hours **up**.

Return the minimum integer `k` such that she finishes in `h` hours.
editorial: k in [1, max(piles)]. Feasible if sum(ceil(p/k)) <= h. Binary search the min feasible k.
